profile.headline: Software Developer at Brainpan, Inc.
profile.jobTitle: Chief Executive Officer & Lead Web Developer
profile.summary: I am an experienced web developer.  I have worked on a multitude of solutions that provided my clients with everything they needed and more.  I am mainly skilled with PHP.  Being a full-stack web developer, front-end technologies are also within my banks of knowledge.  If I do not have a particular skill that is needed, I will pick it up quickly and effectively.

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer & Lead Web Developer
positions.locationName: Post Falls, Idaho, United States · Remote
positions.description: As the founder and driving force behind Garaca Studio LLC, I combine my roles as CEO and lead web developer to deliver custom web and app solutions. My hands-on approach ensures that every project meets our high standards for innovation and excellence. I'm directly involved in every stage, from strategy to coding, providing our clients with personalized services that enhance their online presence. At Garaca Studio, we're dedicated to creating digital experiences that help businesses succeed in the digital landscape.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: The development and design of websites and applications for a multitude of companies.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: The management of all technical aspects regarding services and internal use within the company.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Built many websites using Craft CMS to meet company standards alongside other developers.  Conceptualize and develop new web applications using Laravel. Helped maintain running servers. Responded to and resolved various support requests. Used Zoom and other communication methods to connect with clients. Resolved client website issues with creative solutions. Reviewed client websites and applications for quality assurance. Held daily web meetings with team members to stay up-to-date on current work and help solve problems.

positions.title: Interactive Web Developer
positions.description: Develop new websites from mockups using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with CraftCMS as the backend.  Also fix/change existing sites that are in Drupal, Craft, or Static sites.

company.name: North by Northwest, A Digital Studio

positions.title: Lead PHP Programmer
positions.description: Developed websites using company's proprietary content management system.  Creating custom modules with PHP for CMS and troubleshooting much of the company's legacy code.

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description: Monitor/Maintain Lab Computers and Tutor Software Development Students
